mentions.name: Understory
mentions.description: A Zettelkasten notes app that pushes users to write small, atomic notes and organize them into collections for structure beyond hyperlinking in note text. It uses a browser-like UI with a Notational Velocity-style quick search bar and note addressing, replacing an earlier Miller Columns visualization that was too overwhelming, and is being polished for a beta test.
mentions.source_excerpt: Separately, also working on a Zettelkasten notes app that pushes you to make small, atomic notes that you can organize in "collections" to provide structure beyond just hyperlinking in the note text: https://understory.ussherpress.com/
